name: Toaster
summary: Toast notifications that pop out of a retro toaster and brown as their timer runs out
about: A notification stack fed by a little retro toaster. Press a button and the lever drops, the coils glow, and the toast springs out of the slot with crumbs before landing on the stack. Each toast has a strip that browns from bread to toast as its timer runs out, pauses while you hover, and can be swiped away.
how: Press Saved, Message, Storage or Payment (or the toaster itself) to pop a toast; three fit and the oldest leaves
Hover or focus a toast to pause its browning timer; it pops off by itself when the strip is fully toasted
Use the toast's button: Undo, Open, Clean up or Retry each play a short story and change the toast
Close a toast with the cross, the Escape key, or by swiping it to the right
